'''Choren 1 (September 1)'''

==Events==
</noinclude>
*{{ne|999}} - [[Siuan]]'s party arrive in [[Salidar]]. [[Gareth Bryne]] follows them in, and agrees to lead the army of the Salidar [[Aes Sedai]] against [[Elaida]].
*{{ne|999}} - [[Rand]]'s forces arrive at Eianrod. [[Isendre]] is murdered by [[Kadere]].
*{{ne|999}} - [[Estean]] and [[Edorion]] arrive at Eianrod, telling of [[Couladin]] and the [[Shaido]] besieging [[Cairhien]].
*{{ne|999}} - [[Rand]] and [[Aviendha]] take an unplanned detour. They confront Morsa and her [[Seanchan]] before escaping back to [[Cairhien]].
*Recurring - [[Festival of Lanterns]].
